  <title>Bureau of Life Decisions & Investigations (BLDI)</title>
  <style>
    /* Global Variables and Retro Theme */
    :root {
      --color-primary: #222222;
      --color-cream-light: #fdfcf7;
      --color-cream-medium: #f2ede0;
      --color-cream-dark: #e6dfcb;
      --color-dossier-border: #2c2a29;
      --color-stamp-blue: #1b4d3e;
      --color-stamp-purple: #5c2c6d;
      --color-stamp-red: #b22222;
      --color-glitch-neon: #ff2d2d;
      --color-glitch-bg: #0d0606;
      --font-dossier: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
      --font-title: 'Georgia', serif;
    }

    body {
      background-color: #f7f4eb;
      background-image: radial-gradient(#d3c9b2 1.2px, transparent 1.2px);
      background-size: 24px 24px;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      margin: 0;
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    /* Screen shake for stamps and catastrophic errors */
    @keyframes shake {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0); }
      10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { transform: translate(-4px, 2px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
      20%, 40%, 60%, 80% { transform: translate(4px, -2px) rotate(0.5deg); }
    }
    .screen-shake {
      animation: shake 0.35s ease-out;
    }

    .bldi-container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1100px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Masthead */
    .bldi-header {
      border: 3px double var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    }
    
    .bldi-header::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 5px; left: 5px; right: 5px; bottom: 5px;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .header-seal-container {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .bldi-seal {
      width: 90px;
      height: 90px;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .bldi-header h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.85rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin: 0.5rem 0 0.25rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .bldi-header p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin: 0;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: #555;
    }

    .controls-bar {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding-top: 0.75rem;
    }

    .control-btn {
      background: none;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }
    .control-btn:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-medium);
    }

    /* Main Grid Layout */
    .bldi-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 850px) {
      .bldi-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 420px 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Left panel: Submission & Archive */
    .bldi-sidebar {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Submission Form Panel */
    .bldi-panel {
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    .panel-title {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .form-group {
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .form-label {
      display: block;
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .bldi-textarea {
      width: 100%;
      height: 110px;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      padding: 0.6rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: #fafaf6;
      resize: vertical;
      color: #111;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .bldi-textarea:focus {
      outline: none;
      background-color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0px 0px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    /* Chips */
    .chips-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .suggested-chip {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-medium);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }
    .suggested-chip:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .btn-submit {
      width: 100%;
      background-color: #922b21;
      color: #fff;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.85rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #222;
      transition: all 0.1s ease;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn-submit:hover {
      background-color: #b03a2e;
    }
    .btn-submit:active {
      transform: translate(2px, 2px);
      box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #222;
    }
    .btn-submit:disabled {
      background-color: #888;
      cursor: not-allowed;
      box-shadow: none;
      transform: none;
    }

    /* Archives List */
    .archive-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      max-height: 250px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 0.5rem;
      background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .archive-item {
      padding: 0.6rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      transition: background-color 0.1s;
    }
    .archive-item:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-medium);
    }
    .archive-item .verdict-badge {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      border: 1px solid;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .archive-item .v-approved { color: #1e7e34; border-color: #1e7e34; }
    .archive-item .v-rejected { color: #bd2130; border-color: #bd2130; }
    .archive-item .v-neutral { color: var(--color-stamp-purple); border-color: var(--color-stamp-purple); }

    .no-archives {
      text-align: center;
      color: #666;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    /* Right column: Main investigation stage */
    .bldi-main-stage {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Active Investigation Docket */
    .docket-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* Case Header Docket Card */
    .docket-header-card {
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 20px);
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }
    
    .docket-stamp-watermark {
      position: absolute;
      right: 20px;
      top: 20px;
      opacity: 0.12;
      transform: rotate(12deg);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .docket-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #dcdad4;
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }
    .docket-row:last-of-type {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .docket-value {
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    .status-badge {
      color: #bd2130;
      font-weight: 900;
      animation: pulse-status 1.2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes pulse-status {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; }
    }

    .docket-decision-text {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      background-color: #fafafa;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      position: relative;
    }
    .docket-decision-text::before {
      content: "SUBMITTED ACTION:";
      position: absolute;
      top: -8px;
      left: 10px;
      background-color: #fafafa;
      padding: 0 5px;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    /* Immediate Roast Card */
    .roast-card {
      border: 3px solid #b03a2e;
      background-color: #fdf2e9;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border-left-width: 10px;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .roast-card::before {
      content: "IMMEDIATE AUDIT ROAST";
      position: absolute;
      top: -10px;
      left: 15px;
      background-color: #b03a2e;
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .roast-content {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: #78281f;
      min-height: 3em;
    }

    /* Connecting Departments Progress Bar */
    .connecting-bar-container {
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .connecting-title {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .connecting-bar-bg {
      height: 14px;
      background-color: var(--color-cream-dark);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 2px;
    }
    .connecting-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      background-color: #2b2b2b;
      width: 0%;
      transition: width 0.1s linear;
    }

    /* Department Cards & Progressive Escalation */
    .department-card {
      position: relative;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .dept-meta-index {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #666;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .dept-title {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
      padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .observations-list {
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      padding-left: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .observations-list li {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      list-style-type: square;
    }

    .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .insight-label {
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .punchline-box {
      font-style: italic;
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      border-top: 1px dashed #ccc;
      padding-top: 0.75rem;
      color: #333;
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .punchline-box::before {
      content: "➔ CORONER REPORT:";
      font-weight: 900;
      font-style: normal;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #777;
      white-space: nowrap;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* Progressive visual escalation tiers */

    /* Tier 1: Clean & Orderly (Top of sequence) */
    .tier-clean {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
    }
    .tier-clean .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-blue);
      border: 3px double var(--color-stamp-blue);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      transform: rotate(-4deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.85;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 2: Worn */
    .tier-worn {
      background-color: #faf6eb;
      border: 2px dashed #4a4846;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #4a4846;
    }
    .tier-worn .dept-title {
      color: #2b2b2b;
    }
    .tier-worn .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-purple);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-stamp-purple);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      transform: rotate(6deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.8;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 3: Distressed */
    .tier-distressed {
      background-color: #f5e4e0;
      border: 3px double #7d291e;
      color: #4a1f19;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #7d291e;
      transform: rotate(-0.5deg);
    }
    .tier-distressed .dept-title {
      color: #7d291e;
    }
    .tier-distressed .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(125,41,30,0.06);
      border-left-color: #7d291e;
    }
    .tier-distressed .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #e5b3ae;
      color: #611f18;
    }
    .tier-distressed .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-red);
      border: 2px dashed var(--color-stamp-red);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(-10deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.85;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 4: Glitched */
    .tier-glitched {
      background-color: var(--color-glitch-bg);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-glitch-neon);
      color: #ffb3b3;
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.4);
      clip-path: polygon(
        0% 2%, 4% 0%, 8% 3%, 12% 1%, 16% 4%, 20% 0%, 24% 2%, 28% 1%, 32% 4%, 36% 0%, 
        40% 2%, 44% 1%, 48% 3%, 52% 0%, 56% 2%, 60% 1%, 64% 4%, 68% 0%, 72% 2%, 76% 1%, 
        80% 3%, 84% 0%, 88% 2%, 92% 1%, 96% 4%, 100% 0%, 
        100% 100%, 96% 98%, 92% 99%, 88% 97%, 84% 100%, 80% 98%, 76% 99%, 72% 97%, 68% 100%, 
        64% 98%, 60% 99%, 56% 97%, 52% 100%, 48% 98%, 44% 99%, 40% 97%, 36% 100%, 32% 98%, 
        28% 99%, 24% 97%, 20% 100%, 16% 98%, 12% 99%, 8% 97%, 4% 100%, 0% 98%
      );
      padding-top: 1.8rem;
      padding-bottom: 1.8rem;
    }
    .tier-glitched .dept-title {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      border-bottom-color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.25s infinite;
    }
    .tier-glitched .dept-meta-index {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      opacity: 0.7;
    }
    .tier-glitched .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.08);
      border-left-color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      color: #ffcccc;
    }
    .tier-glitched .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #551a1a;
      color: #ffa1a1;
    }
    .tier-glitched .punchline-box::before {
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
    }
    .tier-glitched .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-glitch-neon);
      border: 3px double var(--color-glitch-neon);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(-15deg) scale(1.05);
      mix-blend-mode: initial;
      text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255,45,45,0.8);
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.18s infinite;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Tier 5: Catastrophic */
    .tier-catastrophic {
      background-color: #000000;
      border: 3px solid #ff0055;
      color: #ffb3d1;
      box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.6);
      clip-path: polygon(
        0% 3%, 5% 0%, 10% 4%, 15% 1%, 20% 5%, 25% 0%, 30% 3%, 35% 1%, 40% 4%, 45% 0%, 
        50% 3%, 55% 1%, 60% 4%, 65% 0%, 70% 3%, 75% 1%, 80% 5%, 85% 0%, 90% 3%, 95% 1%, 100% 4%, 
        100% 100%, 95% 97%, 90% 98%, 85% 96%, 80% 100%, 75% 97%, 70% 98%, 65% 96%, 60% 100%, 
        55% 97%, 50% 98%, 45% 96%, 40% 100%, 35% 97%, 30% 98%, 25% 96%, 20% 100%, 15% 97%, 
        10% 98%, 5% 96%, 0% 100%
      );
      animation: card-shake 0.2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .dept-title {
      color: #ff0055;
      border-bottom-color: #ff0055;
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000, -2px -2px 0px #00ffff;
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.1s infinite;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .dept-meta-index {
      color: #ff0055;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.12);
      border-left-color: #ff0055;
      color: #ffe6f0;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #660022;
      color: #ff99c2;
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .punchline-box::before {
      color: #ff0055;
      content: "➔ ANOMALY OBSERVED:";
    }
    .tier-catastrophic .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: #ff0055;
      border: 3px dashed #ff0055;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(20deg) scale(1.1);
      text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000, -2px -2px 0px #00ffff;
      animation: glitch-jitter 0.08s infinite;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* Glitch Animations */
    @keyframes glitch-jitter {
      0% { transform: translate(0) }
      25% { transform: translate(-1.5px, 1.5px) }
      50% { transform: translate(-1.5px, -1.5px) }

      85% { transform: rotate(-11deg) scale(0.95); opacity: 1; filter: none; }

  <script>
    // --- APP DATA STATE ---
    let appState = {
      history: [],
      isMuted: false,
      isLoading: false,
      customName: "",
      pendingCase: null
    };

    const SUGGESTED_DEBACLES = [
      "Texting my ex 'I miss the dog' at 2:14 AM.",

      "Investing my life savings into a cryptocurrency named after a cartoon toad.",

      "Buying an industrial espresso machine for $2,000 to save money on daily lattes.",
      "Going to law school because I like arguing and watched three seasons of Suits."
    ];

    // --- KEYWORDS MAP FOR LOCAL CONTENT GENERATOR ---
    const KEYWORDS = {
      relationships: ["ex", "love", "date", "texting", "tinder", "proposing", "relationship", "girlfriend", "boyfriend", "marry", "divorce"],
      money: ["investing", "crypto", "money", "buy", "car", "sports car", "savings", "latte", "purchase", "shopping", "broke", "bank", "credit card", "debt", "spend"],
      career: ["job", "quit", "career", "school", "law school", "corporate", "resign", "degree", "boss", "work", "office", "business", "employ"],
      health: ["food", "gym", "eat", "starving", "espresso", "diet", "sleep", "coffee", "exercise", "weight", "workout", "smoke"],
      validation: ["social media", "clout", "instagram", "tiktok", "validation", "likes", "followers", "post", "facebook", "views", "reddit", "twitter"],
      procrastination: ["procrastination", "sleep", "tomorrow", "lazy", "ignore", "avoiding", "later", "procrastinate", "ignore", "delay"]
    };

    // --- AUDIO GENERATION (Web Audio API) ---
    let audioCtx = null;

    function initAudio() {
      if (!audioCtx) {
        audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      }
    }

    function playTypewriterKey() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      
      const freq = 800 + Math.random() * 400;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.04, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
    }

    function playRetroPing() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(900, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.08);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
    }

    function playStampSlam() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc1 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const osc2 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc1.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(65, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(20, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.35);
      
      osc2.type = 'sine';
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(45, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(15, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.4);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.4, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
      
      osc1.connect(gain);
      osc2.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      
      osc1.start();
      osc2.start();
      osc1.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
      osc2.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
    }

    // --- UI HELPERS ---
    function renderSuggestions() {
      const box = document.getElementById("chips-box");
      box.innerHTML = "";
      SUGGESTED_DEBACLES.forEach(choice => {
        const chip = document.createElement("button");
        chip.type = "button";
        chip.className = "suggested-chip";
        chip.textContent = choice;
        chip.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.getElementById("decision-input").value = choice;
          playTypewriterKey();
        });
        box.appendChild(chip);
      });
    }

    async function loadHistory() {
      try {
        const res = await window.archestra.storage.user.get("bldi_history");
        if (res && Array.isArray(res.value)) {
          appState.history = res.value;
          renderHistoryUI();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load history from storage:", err);
      }
    }

    async function saveCaseToHistory(caseData) {
      if (appState.history.some(h => h.caseId === caseData.caseId)) return;
      
      appState.history.unshift(caseData);
      if (appState.history.length > 25) {
        appState.history = appState.history.slice(0, 25);
      }
      
      renderHistoryUI();
      try {
        await window.archestra.storage.user.set("bldi_history", appState.history);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to save history to storage:", err);
      }
    }

    function renderHistoryUI() {
      const container = document.getElementById("archive-container");
      container.innerHTML = "";

      if (appState.history.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-archives">No active citizen record on file.</div>';
        return;
      }

      appState.history.forEach(item => {
        const div = document.createElement("div");
        div.className = "archive-item";
        div.style.display = "flex";
        div.style.flexDirection = "column";
        div.style.gap = "0.5rem";
        div.style.cursor = "default";
        
        let vClass = "v-neutral";
        if (item.verdict.includes("APPROVED")) vClass = "v-approved";
        if (item.verdict.includes("REJECTED")) vClass = "v-rejected";

        div.innerHTML = `
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%;">
            <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0;">
              <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.8rem; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">
                ${item.caseId}
              </div>
              <div style="font-style: italic; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #555; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; margin-top: 0.15rem;">
                "${item.input}"
              </div>
              <div style="color: #777; font-size: 0.6rem; margin-top: 0.25rem;">
                ${new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
              </div>
            </div>
            <span class="verdict-badge ${vClass}" style="align-self: flex-start;">${item.verdict}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; width: 100%; border-top: 1px dashed #dcdad4; padding-top: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.1rem;">
            <button class="control-btn review-btn" style="padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: bold; margin: 0; cursor: pointer;">
              REVIEW IN FACILITY
            </button>
          </div>
        `;

        // Wire click exclusively to the "REVIEW IN FACILITY" button inside the card
        const btnReview = div.querySelector(".review-btn");
        btnReview.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          playRetroPing();
          displayCase(item);
        });

        container.appendChild(div);
      });
    }

    function displayCase(caseData) {
      document.getElementById("welcome-panel").classList.add("hidden");
      
      const docket = document.getElementById("case-docket");
      docket.classList.remove("hidden");

      // Hide temporary states
      document.getElementById("connecting-loader").classList.add("hidden");
      document.getElementById("crisis-card-element").classList.add("hidden");

      // Set Case details
      document.getElementById("case-id-display").textContent = caseData.caseId;
      document.getElementById("subject-name-display").textContent = caseData.subjectName || appState.customName || "Citizen Default";
      document.getElementById("case-date-display").textContent = new Date(caseData.timestamp).toLocaleString();
      document.getElementById("case-status-display").textContent = "AUDIT COMPLETED";
      document.getElementById("case-status-display").style.color = "#1e7e34";
      document.getElementById("docket-user-text").textContent = caseData.input;

      // Roast Card
      const roastCard = document.getElementById("roast-card-element");
      roastCard.classList.remove("hidden");
      document.getElementById("roast-text-container").textContent = caseData.roast;
      document.getElementById("debug-error-container").style.display = "none";

      // Render departments instantly
      const deptBox = document.getElementById("departments-container");
      deptBox.innerHTML = "";
      
      caseData.departments.forEach((dept, idx) => {
        const card = createDepartmentCard(dept, idx, caseData.departments.length);
        deptBox.appendChild(card);
      });

      // Show final verdict instantly
      const verdictCard = document.getElementById("verdict-card-element");
      verdictCard.classList.remove("hidden");
      
      const stamp = document.getElementById("verdict-stamp");
      stamp.className = "bldi-official-stamp";
      
      const verifiedVerdict = normalizeVerdict(caseData.verdict);
      
      if (verifiedVerdict.includes("APPROVED WITH REGRET") || verifiedVerdict.includes("CONDITIONALLY APPROVED") || verifiedVerdict.includes("UNDER LIFELONG REVIEW")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-review");
      } else if (verifiedVerdict.includes("APPROVED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-approved");
      } else if (verifiedVerdict.includes("REJECTED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-rejected");
      } else {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-referred");
      }
      
      stamp.textContent = verifiedVerdict;
      stamp.style.opacity = "0.95";
      stamp.style.transform = "rotate(-10deg) scale(1)";
      
      document.getElementById("verdict-reason").textContent = caseData.verdictReason || "Central Bureau Verdict Confirmed.";

      document.getElementById("docket-header").scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function getEscalationTier(idx, total) {
      const ratio = idx / (total - 1 || 1);
      if (ratio < 0.2) return { tierClass: "tier-clean", stampText: "INITIALIZED" };

      }, 500);

      appState.pendingCase = {

        input: inputText,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        roast: resultPayload.roast,
        departments: depts,
        verdict: finalVerdict,
        verdictReason: resultPayload.verdictReason,

    // --- SETUP EVENT LISTENERS & INITIALIZATION ---
    function setupEventListeners() {
      // Submission form listener
      const form = document.getElementById("submission-form");
      form.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = document.getElementById("decision-input").value.trim();
        if (input && !appState.isLoading) {
          processCaseSubmission(input);
        }
      });

      // Sound Toggle Listener
      const muteBtn = document.getElementById("mute-btn");
      muteBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        appState.isMuted = !appState.isMuted;
        const icon = document.getElementById("mute-icon");
        const text = document.getElementById("mute-text");
        if (appState.isMuted) {

        } else {

          text.textContent = "Sound: ON";

        }
      });

      const btnAcknowledge = document.getElementById("btn-acknowledge");
      btnAcknowledge.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        playRetroPing();
        
        // Save to archive list if we have a pending case
        if (appState.pendingCase) {
          const btnSubmit = document.getElementById("submit-case-btn");
          btnSubmit.disabled = true;
          await saveCaseToHistory(appState.pendingCase);
          appState.pendingCase = null;
          btnSubmit.disabled = false;

        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });

        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

    function setupNameEditing() {
      const nameContainer = document.getElementById("citizen-name-container");
      const displayName = document.getElementById("user-display-name");
      const editIcon = document.getElementById("edit-name-icon");
      
      let isEditing = false;

      function startEditing(e) {
        if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();
        if (isEditing) return;
        isEditing = true;

        const currentName = appState.customName || displayName.textContent || "Citizen Default";
        
        // Hide standard display and edit icon
        displayName.style.display = "none";
        editIcon.style.display = "none";

        // Create input element
        const input = document.createElement("input");
        input.type = "text";
        input.value = currentName;
        input.className = "citizen-name-input";
        input.style.fontFamily = "var(--font-dossier)";
        input.style.fontSize = "0.85rem";
        input.style.fontWeight = "bold";
        input.style.border = "1px solid var(--color-dossier-border)";
        input.style.backgroundColor = "var(--color-cream-light)";
        input.style.padding = "0.1rem 0.3rem";
        input.style.color = "var(--color-primary)";
        input.style.width = "140px";
        
        nameContainer.appendChild(input);
        input.focus();
        input.select();

        function finishEditing() {
          if (!isEditing) return;
          isEditing = false;

          const newName = input.value.trim();
          if (newName) {
            appState.customName = newName;
            displayName.textContent = newName;
            
            // Reflect instantly in any active docket subject display
            const subjectDisplay = document.getElementById("subject-name-display");
            if (subjectDisplay) {
              subjectDisplay.textContent = newName;
            }
          }

          // Cleanup and restore
          if (input.parentNode) {
            input.parentNode.removeChild(input);
          }
          displayName.style.display = "";
          editIcon.style.display = "";
        }

        input.addEventListener("blur", finishEditing);
        input.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
          if (ev.stopPropagation) ev.stopPropagation();
          if (ev.key === "Enter") {
            finishEditing();
          } else if (ev.key === "Escape") {
            input.value = currentName;
            finishEditing();
          }
        });

        input.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
          if (ev.stopPropagation) ev.stopPropagation();
        });
      }

      // Trigger editing only on clicking the edit pencil or the display text
      displayName.addEventListener("click", startEditing);
      editIcon.addEventListener("click", startEditing);
    }

    window.addEventListener("load", async () => {
      renderSuggestions();
      
      try {
        // Await Archestra Ready to resolve username correctly
        await window.archestra.ready;
        if (window.archestra.user && window.archestra.user.name) {
          appState.customName = window.archestra.user.name;
        } else {
          appState.customName = "Citizen Default";
        }
        document.getElementById("user-display-name").textContent = appState.customName;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Archestra SDK initialization failed:", e);
        appState.customName = "Honored Citizen";
        document.getElementById("user-display-name").textContent = appState.customName;
      }

      setupEventListeners();
      setupNameEditing();
      await loadHistory();
    });
  </script>
</body>

  <title>Bureau of Life Decisions & Investigations (BLDI)</title>
  <style>
    /* Global Variables and Retro Theme */
    :root {
      --color-primary: #222222;
      --color-cream-light: #fdfcf7;
      --color-cream-medium: #f2ede0;
      --color-cream-dark: #e6dfcb;
      --color-dossier-border: #2c2a29;
      --color-stamp-blue: #1b4d3e;
      --color-stamp-purple: #5c2c6d;
      --color-stamp-red: #b22222;
      --color-glitch-neon: #ff2d2d;
      --color-glitch-bg: #0d0606;
      --font-dossier: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
      --font-title: 'Georgia', serif;
    }

    body {
      background-color: #f7f4eb;
      background-image: radial-gradient(#d3c9b2 1.2px, transparent 1.2px);
      background-size: 24px 24px;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      margin: 0;
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    /* Screen shake for stamps and catastrophic errors */
    @keyframes shake {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0); }
      10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { transform: translate(-4px, 2px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
      20%, 40%, 60%, 80% { transform: translate(4px, -2px) rotate(0.5deg); }
    }
    .screen-shake {
      animation: shake 0.35s ease-out;
    }

    .bldi-container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1100px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Masthead */
    .bldi-header {
      border: 3px double var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    }
    
    .bldi-header::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 5px; left: 5px; right: 5px; bottom: 5px;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .header-seal-container {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .bldi-seal {
      width: 90px;
      height: 90px;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .bldi-header h1 {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.85rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin: 0.5rem 0 0.25rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .bldi-header p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin: 0;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.5px;
      color: #555;
    }

    .controls-bar {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding-top: 0.75rem;
    }

    .control-btn {
      background: none;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }
    .control-btn:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-medium);
    }

    /* Main Grid Layout */
    .bldi-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 850px) {
      .bldi-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 420px 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Left panel: Submission & Archive */
    .bldi-sidebar {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Submission Form Panel */
    .bldi-panel {
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    .panel-title {
      font-family: var(--font-title);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .form-group {
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .form-label {
      display: block;
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .bldi-textarea {
      width: 100%;
      height: 110px;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      padding: 0.6rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: #fafaf6;
      resize: vertical;
      color: #111;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .bldi-textarea:focus {
      outline: none;
      background-color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0px 0px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    /* Chips */
    .chips-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .suggested-chip {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-medium);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }
    .suggested-chip:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: white;
    }

    .btn-submit {
      width: 100%;
      background-color: #922b21;
      color: #fff;
      font-family: var(--font-dossier);
      font-weight: bold;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.85rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #222;
      transition: all 0.1s ease;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn-submit:hover {
      background-color: #b03a2e;
    }
    .btn-submit:active {
      transform: translate(2px, 2px);
      box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #222;
    }
    .btn-submit:disabled {
      background-color: #888;
      cursor: not-allowed;
      box-shadow: none;
      transform: none;
    }

    /* Archives List */
    .archive-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      max-height: 250px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 0.5rem;
      background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .archive-item {
      padding: 0.6rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      transition: background-color 0.1s;
    }
    .archive-item:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-cream-medium);
    }
    .archive-item .verdict-badge {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      border: 1px solid;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .archive-item .v-approved { color: #1e7e34; border-color: #1e7e34; }
    .archive-item .v-rejected { color: #bd2130; border-color: #bd2130; }
    .archive-item .v-neutral { color: var(--color-stamp-purple); border-color: var(--color-stamp-purple); }

    .no-archives {
      text-align: center;
      color: #666;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    /* Right column: Main investigation stage */
    .bldi-main-stage {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Active Investigation Docket */
    .docket-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* Case Header Docket Card */
    .docket-header-card {
      border: 3px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 20px);
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }
    
    .docket-stamp-watermark {
      position: absolute;
      right: 20px;
      top: 20px;
      opacity: 0.12;
      transform: rotate(12deg);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .docket-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #dcdad4;
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }
    .docket-row:last-of-type {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .docket-value {
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    .status-badge {
      color: #bd2130;
      font-weight: 900;
      animation: pulse-status 1.2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes pulse-status {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; }
    }

    .docket-decision-text {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      background-color: #fafafa;
      border: 1px dashed var(--color-dossier-border);
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.4;
      position: relative;

    .docket-decision-text::before {
      content: "SUBMITTED ACTION:";

      top: -8px;
      left: 10px;
      background-color: #fafafa;
      padding: 0 5px;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    /* Immediate Roast Card */
    .roast-card {
      border: 3px solid #b03a2e;
      background-color: #fdf2e9;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border-left-width: 10px;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .roast-card::before {
      content: "IMMEDIATE AUDIT ROAST";
      position: absolute;
      top: -10px;
      left: 15px;
      background-color: #b03a2e;
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .roast-content {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: #78281f;
      min-height: 3em;

    /* Connecting Departments Progress Bar */
    .connecting-bar-container {
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      background-color: var(--color-cream-light);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);

    .connecting-title {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;

      border: 1px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      padding: 2px;

    .connecting-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      background-color: #2b2b2b;
      width: 0%;
      transition: width 0.1s linear;

      position: relative;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-dossier-border);
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);

      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;

      border-bottom: 2px solid currentColor;
      padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      padding-left: 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.5;

    .observations-list li {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      list-style-type: square;

      background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.03);

      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      line-height: 1.4;

      text-transform: uppercase;

      font-weight: bold;

      border-top: 1px dashed #ccc;

      color: #333;
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;

      font-style: normal;

      white-space: nowrap;

      color: #2b2b2b;

      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-purple);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-stamp-purple);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: bold;
      transform: rotate(6deg);

      opacity: 0.8;
      text-transform: uppercase;

    .tier-distressed {

      color: #4a1f19;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #7d291e;
      transform: rotate(-0.5deg);

    .tier-distressed .dept-title {
      color: #7d291e;

    .tier-distressed .insight-box {
      background-color: rgba(125,41,30,0.06);
      border-left-color: #7d291e;
    }
    .tier-distressed .punchline-box {
      border-top-color: #e5b3ae;
      color: #611f18;
    }
    .tier-distressed .bldi-stamp-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 15px;
      top: 15px;
      color: var(--color-stamp-red);
      border: 2px dashed var(--color-stamp-red);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      transform: rotate(-10deg);
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      opacity: 0.85;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    };

    // --- AUDIO GENERATION (Web Audio API) ---
    let audioCtx = null;

    function initAudio() {
      if (!audioCtx) {
        audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      }
    }

    function playTypewriterKey() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      
      const freq = 800 + Math.random() * 400;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.04, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.04);
    }

    function playRetroPing() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(900, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.08);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
      
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
    }

    function playStampSlam() {
      if (appState.isMuted) return;
      initAudio();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

      const osc1 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const osc2 = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc1.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(65, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(20, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.35);
      
      osc2.type = 'sine';
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(45, audioCtx.currentTime);
      osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(15, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.4);
      
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.4, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
      
      osc1.connect(gain);
      osc2.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      
      osc1.start();
      osc2.start();
      osc1.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
      osc2.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.45);
    }

    // --- UI HELPERS ---
    function renderSuggestions() {
      const box = document.getElementById("chips-box");
      box.innerHTML = "";
      SUGGESTED_DEBACLES.forEach(choice => {
        const chip = document.createElement("button");
        chip.type = "button";
        chip.className = "suggested-chip";
        chip.textContent = choice;
        chip.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.getElementById("decision-input").value = choice;
          playTypewriterKey();
        });
        box.appendChild(chip);
      });
    }

    async function loadHistory() {
      try {
        const res = await window.archestra.storage.user.get("bldi_history");
        if (res && Array.isArray(res.value)) {
          appState.history = res.value;
          renderHistoryUI();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to load history from storage:", err);
      }
    }

    async function saveCaseToHistory(caseData) {
      if (appState.history.some(h => h.caseId === caseData.caseId)) return;
      
      appState.history.unshift(caseData);
      if (appState.history.length > 25) {
        appState.history = appState.history.slice(0, 25);
      }
      
      renderHistoryUI();
      try {
        await window.archestra.storage.user.set("bldi_history", appState.history);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to save history to storage:", err);
      }

      const container = document.getElementById("archive-container");
      container.innerHTML = "";

      if (appState.history.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-archives">No active citizen record on file.</div>';

        div.style.flexDirection = "column";

        if (item.verdict.includes("REJECTED")) vClass = "v-rejected";

        div.innerHTML = `
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%;">
            <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0;">
              <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 0.8rem; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;">
                ${item.caseId}
              </div>
              <div style="font-style: italic; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #555; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; margin-top: 0.15rem;">

        resultPayload.caseId = generatedCaseId; // Keep generatedCaseId consistent
      }

      // Handle Crisis Exception
      if (resultPayload.crisis) {
        statusDisplay.textContent = "SAFETY REDIRECT";
        statusDisplay.style.color = "#ff0055";
        document.getElementById("crisis-message-text").textContent = resultPayload.message || "A brief caring message.";
        crisisCard.classList.remove("hidden");
        crisisCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        btnSubmit.disabled = false;
        appState.isLoading = false;
        return;
      }

      // 2. Immediate Roast — Revealed and typed out
      statusDisplay.textContent = "ROASTING CITIZEN";
      roastCard.classList.remove("hidden");
      roastCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });

      const roastTextContainer = document.getElementById("roast-text-container");
      roastTextContainer.textContent = "";
      
      const roastString = resultPayload.roast || "No roast delivered.";
      for (let i = 0; i < roastString.length; i++) {
        roastTextContainer.textContent += roastString[i];
        if (i % 3 === 0) playTypewriterKey();
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 15));
      }

      // 3. Connecting Departments — brief loading animation (progress bar/dots)
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600));
      statusDisplay.textContent = "CONNECTING bureaus";
      connectingLoader.classList.remove("hidden");
      connectingLoader.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });

      const barFill = document.getElementById("connecting-bar-fill");
      const pctText = document.getElementById("connecting-pct");
      
      const animationSteps = 20;
      for (let step = 1; step <= animationSteps; step++) {
        const pct = Math.floor((step / animationSteps) * 100);
        barFill.style.width = `${pct}%`;
        pctText.textContent = `${pct}%`;
        if (step % 4 === 0) playRetroPing();
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
      }

      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 400));
      connectingLoader.classList.add("hidden");

      // 4. 6-10 Departments — rendered one by one with a short delay between each
      statusDisplay.textContent = "DEPARTMENTS AUDITING";
      const depts = resultPayload.departments || [];
      const totalDepts = depts.length;

      for (let idx = 0; idx < totalDepts; idx++) {
        const dept = depts[idx];
        const card = createDepartmentCard(dept, idx, totalDepts);
        deptBox.appendChild(card);
        card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
        playStampSlam();
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
      }

      // 5. Final Verdict — with a CSS-drawn official stamp graphic
      statusDisplay.textContent = "DETERMINING FINAL DISPOSITION";
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800));

      verdictCard.classList.remove("hidden");
      verdictCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });

      // Clean CSS classes and apply verdict styling
      stamp.className = "bldi-official-stamp"; 
      
      const finalVerdict = normalizeVerdict(resultPayload.verdict);
      if (finalVerdict.includes("APPROVED WITH REGRET") || finalVerdict.includes("CONDITIONALLY APPROVED") || finalVerdict.includes("UNDER LIFELONG REVIEW")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-review");
      } else if (finalVerdict.includes("APPROVED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-approved");
      } else if (finalVerdict.includes("REJECTED")) {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-rejected");
      } else {
        stamp.classList.add("verdict-color-referred");
      }

      stamp.textContent = finalVerdict;
      document.getElementById("verdict-reason").textContent = resultPayload.verdictReason || "Official verdict compiled and logged.";

      // Slam Stamp Action
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
      stamp.classList.add("stamped");
      playStampSlam();
      document.body.classList.add("screen-shake");
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.classList.remove("screen-shake");
      }, 500);

      // Save pending case data to state (to be archived on clicking acknowledge button)
      appState.pendingCase = {
        caseId: generatedCaseId,
        input: inputText,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        roast: resultPayload.roast,
        departments: depts,
        verdict: finalVerdict,
        verdictReason: resultPayload.verdictReason,
        subjectName: appState.customName || "Citizen Default"
      };

      // Complete Case Header updates
      statusDisplay.textContent = "AUDIT COMPLETED";
      statusDisplay.style.color = "#1e7e34";

      // Re-enable Form Submit button
      btnSubmit.disabled = false;
      appState.isLoading = false;
    }

    // --- SETUP EVENT LISTENERS & INITIALIZATION ---
    function setupEventListeners() {
      // Submission form listener
      const form = document.getElementById("submission-form");
      form.addEventListener("submit", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = document.getElementById("decision-input").value.trim();
        if (input && !appState.isLoading) {
          processCaseSubmission(input);
        }
      });

      // Sound Toggle Listener
      const muteBtn = document.getElementById("mute-btn");
      muteBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        appState.isMuted = !appState.isMuted;
        const icon = document.getElementById("mute-icon");
        const text = document.getElementById("mute-text");
        if (appState.isMuted) {
          icon.textContent = "🔇";
          text.textContent = "Sound: OFF";
        } else {
          icon.textContent = "🔊";
          text.textContent = "Sound: ON";
          playRetroPing();
        }
      });

      // Acknowledge Button Listener (Saves completed case into archives, then resets the form)
      const btnAcknowledge = document.getElementById("btn-acknowledge");
      btnAcknowledge.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        playRetroPing();
        
        // Save to archive list if we have a pending case
        if (appState.pendingCase) {
          const btnSubmit = document.getElementById("submit-case-btn");
          btnSubmit.disabled = true;
          await saveCaseToHistory(appState.pendingCase);
          appState.pendingCase = null;
          btnSubmit.disabled = false;
        }

        // Reset the form
        document.getElementById("decision-input").value = "";
        
        // Hide case-docket & show welcome panel
        document.getElementById("case-docket").classList.add("hidden");
        document.getElementById("welcome-panel").classList.remove("hidden");
        
        // Scroll back to top
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      // Safety Crisis Reset Button
      const btnCrisisAcknowledge = document.getElementById("btn-crisis-acknowledge");
      btnCrisisAcknowledge.addEventListener("click", () => {
        playRetroPing();
        document.getElementById("decision-input").value = "";
        document.getElementById("case-docket").classList.add("hidden");
        document.getElementById("welcome-panel").classList.remove("hidden");
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
    }

    // Editable Citizen Name setup
    function setupNameEditing() {
      const nameContainer = document.getElementById("citizen-name-container");
      const displayName = document.getElementById("user-display-name");
      const editIcon = document.getElementById("edit-name-icon");
      
      let isEditing = false;

      function startEditing(e) {
        if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();
        if (isEditing) return;
        isEditing = true;

        const currentName = appState.customName || displayName.textContent || "Citizen Default";
        
        // Hide standard display and edit icon
        displayName.style.display = "none";
        editIcon.style.display = "none";

        // Create input element
        const input = document.createElement("input");
        input.type = "text";
        input.value = currentName;
        input.className = "citizen-name-input";
        input.style.fontFamily = "var(--font-dossier)";
        input.style.fontSize = "0.85rem";
        input.style.fontWeight = "bold";
        input.style.border = "1px solid var(--color-dossier-border)";
        input.style.backgroundColor = "var(--color-cream-light)";
        input.style.padding = "0.1rem 0.3rem";
        input.style.color = "var(--color-primary)";
        input.style.width = "140px";
        
        nameContainer.appendChild(input);
        input.focus();
        input.select();

        function finishEditing() {
          if (!isEditing) return;
          isEditing = false;

          const newName = input.value.trim();
          if (newName) {
            appState.customName = newName;
            displayName.textContent = newName;
            
            // Reflect instantly in any active docket subject display
            const subjectDisplay = document.getElementById("subject-name-display");
            if (subjectDisplay) {
              subjectDisplay.textContent = newName;
            }
          }

          // Cleanup and restore
          if (input.parentNode) {
            input.parentNode.removeChild(input);
          }
          displayName.style.display = "";
          editIcon.style.display = "";
        }

        input.addEventListener("blur", finishEditing);
        input.addEventListener("keydown", (ev) => {
          if (ev.stopPropagation) ev.stopPropagation();
          if (ev.key === "Enter") {
            finishEditing();
          } else if (ev.key === "Escape") {
            input.value = currentName;
            finishEditing();
          }
        });

        input.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
          if (ev.stopPropagation) ev.stopPropagation();
        });
      }

      // Trigger editing only on clicking the edit pencil or the display text
      displayName.addEventListener("click", startEditing);
      editIcon.addEventListener("click", startEditing);
    }

    window.addEventListener("load", async () => {
      renderSuggestions();
      
      try {
        // Await Archestra Ready to resolve username correctly
        await window.archestra.ready;
        if (window.archestra.user && window.archestra.user.name) {
          appState.customName = window.archestra.user.name;
        } else {
          appState.customName = "Citizen Default";
        }
        document.getElementById("user-display-name").textContent = appState.customName;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Archestra SDK initialization failed:", e);
        appState.customName = "Honored Citizen";
        document.getElementById("user-display-name").textContent = appState.customName;
      }

      setupEventListeners();
      setupNameEditing();
      await loadHistory();
    });
  </script>

</body></html>
